---
title: "Correct or replace a release"
subtitle: "Correct the authoritative source, then repeat the controlled workflow"
date: 2026-08-11
date-modified: 2026-08-21
---

**Status:** Operational framework.  
**Owner:** BNR Lead and BNR Analyst.

## Purpose

Correct a published product transparently while preserving reproducibility, approval evidence and the distinction between Stata analytics and Quarto presentation.

## Step 1: Assess and contain

1. Record who identified the issue, when, and which release, files and pages are affected.
2. Classify the cause as source data, analytical code, configuration, interpretation or website presentation.
3. Decide whether statistics, conclusions, disclosure risk or users are affected.
4. If confidentiality may have been breached, follow the authorised incident route and notify the BNR Lead immediately.

## Step 2: Choose the correction point

| Problem | Correct here |
|---|---|
| Source data or source-record classification | Authoritative source system or controlled source dataset |
| Calculation or programmed rule | Version-controlled Stata code or configuration |
| Approved result described incorrectly | Quarto narrative, with substantive review if interpretation changes |
| Typographical or layout problem only | Quarto source |

Never edit a generated analytical output to make it appear correct.

## Step 3: Regenerate the analytical release

1. Start from the earliest Stata step affected by the correction.
2. Use a new identifiable package or an explicitly authorised replacement supported by the workflow.
3. Repeat data-quality, analytical and disclosure review for every affected output.
4. Record a new approval through the relevant Stata approval step.
5. Publish through the relevant Stata publication step and verify both the authoritative package and website mirror.

Use the [CVD events](../post-redcap/dashboard-workflow.qmd), [CVD mortality](../post-redcap/mortality-workflow.qmd), [tabulations](../post-redcap/tabulations-workflow.qmd) or [briefings](../post-redcap/briefings-workflow.qmd) procedure as appropriate.

## Step 4: Update the public presentation

1. In VS Code, update affected Quarto narrative, listings or links.
2. Add a correction note when readers need to understand a material change.
3. Preview the affected pages and run a complete Quarto render.
4. Inspect Git changes, commit and push the public-safe correction.
5. Check the live site and notify affected users where required.

## Replacement rule

Do not overwrite an earlier release merely to hide an error. Preserve the superseded authoritative package and a record of what changed, why, who authorised it and which public product replaced it.

::: {.callout-warning title="BNR confirmation required"}
Confirm who can order urgent withdrawal, where superseded packages are retained, when a public correction notice is required and how affected data users are notified.
:::
